customer: So I'm a college student here in Aldora and I've got this coupe I really need to sell before next semester, but I don't have a ride to get it anywhere once it's sold, and honestly between classes and my part-time job I barely have time to drive across town anyway. agent: Good news: our Home pickup service is available in every state we serve, and there's no charge for it. A Northwind specialist can come to your home or office, inspect your coupe, bring the paperwork, and complete the sale right there, paying you by bank draft.
